data.title: FCPT Declares Fourth Quarter 2026 Monthly Dividends
data.description: A real estate investment trust, Four Corners Property Trust, Inc. (NYSE: FCPT), based in Mill Valley, California, declared monthly cash dividends of $0.1265 per share ($1.5180 per share annually) for the fourth quarter of 2026. The dividends will be payable in cash to common stock shareholders of record as of the record date. This marks a 3.5% increase from the previous quarter. The payment dates are outlined in a table provided by the company's Board of Directors.

data.title: /C O R R E C T I O N -- Jollibee/
data.description: Jollibee has announced a new partnership with DreamWorks Animation's latest original film, Forgotten Island, on 08-Sep-2026. The collaboration aims to celebrate friendship and Filipino culture in an exclusive venture. The news comes as part of a press release shared by Jollibee, showcasing their commitment to showcasing cultural values through unique collaborations. This partnership marks a significant move for both companies, with plans to reach a large audience and promote the essence of camaraderie and Filipino heritage. Jollibee's association with DreamWorks Animation's latest project underscores their dedication to fostering meaningful connections and promoting cultural diversity. This joint effort is expected to resonate with a broad audience, highlighting the essence of friendship and the richness of Filipino traditions.

data.title: Omnis Energy: Judge Disqualifies HSF Kramer from Representing Pleasants Power Station in Bankruptcy Case
data.description: In Wilmington, Delaware, as of September 11, 2026, Young Conaway will continue to represent Pleasants Power Station as the U.S. Bankruptcy Court has removed HSF Kramer from the Chapter 11 proceedings. This decision comes following objections raised regarding the representation. The court-directed sale and challenges by Omnis are proceeding as planned. This development will impact the future of the power station and involves significant financial and legal implications.

data.title: Boo Bash Fall Festival to Make California Debut September 18, Bringing 100,000+ Square-Foot Immersive Pumpkin Patch to Escondido
data.description: A new fall attraction is coming to Mershops North County Mall in Escondido, California on September 11, 2026. This six-week event, named Boo Bash, will feature five unique zones and activities suitable for all age groups. It will offer a seasonal pumpkin patch and a family-oriented fall festival. This transformation promises to turn the mall into a popular destination for the season, providing a variety of entertainment options and immersive experiences.

data.title: Biohaven Investigation Notice: SueWallSt Notifies Investors of Pending Investigation Into Biohaven (BHVN)
data.description: On September 10, 2026, Biohaven Ltd (NYSE: BHVN) experienced a significant decrease in share value by almost 15% in one session. This decrease followed the FDA's decision to partially halt new-patient enrollment in the BHV-7000/opakalim epilepsy trials. Specifically, Biohaven shares plummeted by $2.21, representing approximately a 14.73% drop. This news impacted the market greatly, causing concern among investors about the future prospects of the company.
